problem_text:
A company must allocate computational tasks across a network of distributed servers (group S) to processing nodes (group P) in order to minimize total latency.

The available processing capacity at each server (set S) is defined as:
*Server S1 has 124 units of capacity.
*Server S2 has 58 units.
*Server S3 has 109 units.
*Server S4 has 123 units.
*Server S5 has 122 units.
*Server S6 has 166 units.

The required computational load at each processing node (set P) is stipulated:
*Node P1 must handle 36 units of load.
*Node P2 must handle 41 units.
*Node P3 must handle 120 units.
*Node P4 must handle 89 units.
*Node P5 must handle 122 units.
*Node P6 must handle 30 units.

The latency per unit of load transferred from each server to each node is provided in the matrix:
| Source / Target | P1 | P2 | P3 | P4 | P5 | P6 |
|--|-|-|-|-|-|
| S1 | 4 | 18 | 8 | 5 | 9 | 5 |
| S2 | 3 | 2 | 6 | 10 | 20 | 19 |
| S3 | 10 | 15 | 4 | 15 | 10 | 13 |
| S4 | 9 | 17 | 18 | 16 | 15 | 3 |
| S5 | 20 | 2 | 14 | 11 | 20 | 9 |
| S6 | 1 | 3 | 8 | 19 | 19 | 1 |

Determine the optimal allocation of computational loads to minimize the aggregate network latency.
